imageAlt: Khariidadda Soomaaliya oo muujinaysa dowlad goboleedka Hirshabeelle
summary: Dawan Africa ayaa sheegtay in golaha wasiirada Hirshabeelle, oo uu shir-guddoominayay Madaxweyne Guudlaawe, ay ansixiyeen miisaaniyadda 2027, taas oo 7% ka badan tii 2026. Shirka ayaa sidoo kale looga hadlay amniga, doorashooyinka iyo u diyaargarowga fatahaadaha.
title: Hirshabeelle oo ansixisay miisaaniyad $47.45 milyan ah oo sannadka 2027
